title: Curve get_virtual_price in checkBalance enables flash-loan yield inflation
claimed_impact: A privileged attacker (operator or strategist) can flash-loan large amounts into the Curve pool, inflate get_virtual_price(), then trigger rebase() in the same block to artificially increase OETH/OETHb supply beyond real backing. Normal rebasing holders receive inflated yield that is not backed by real assets, diluting the protocol's real backing ratio. Over multiple executions, this erodes the 1:1 OETH:WETH backing peg. Additionally, this same price can be used in the _withdrawAndRemoveFromPool() slippage calculation (see FL-002).
